title.name: Title
title.description: The main title displayed on the tile.

subtitle.name: Subtitle
subtitle.description: An optional subtitle displayed below the title.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: UI5 icon name displayed on the tile.

value.name: Value
value.description: Numeric or text value displayed prominently on the tile. When set, the tile renders in numeric mode.

valueColor.name: Value Color
valueColor.description: Semantic color applied to the value text.

footer.name: Footer
footer.description: Optional footer text displayed at the bottom of the tile.

tcode.name: Transaction Code
tcode.description: Optional SAP transaction code displayed in a side strip on the tile.
